# Vocabulary: sim_scale

Spatial or organizational scale of the primary simulated unit of play.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `micro` | Micro | Sub-individual (cells, organs, components, particles). |
| `individual` | Individual | One person, creature, or vehicle. |
| `household` | Household / crew | A small group of named individuals (family, crew, squad). |
| `facility` | Facility | One site such as a park, hospital, factory, or farm. |
| `settlement` | Settlement | Village, colony, or base of tens to hundreds of agents. |
| `city` | City | Urban area of thousands to millions. |
| `region` | Region | Multi-settlement territory or transport network. |
| `nation` | Nation / polity | One or more states. |
| `planet` | Planet | Whole-world climate, biosphere, or civilization. |
| `interplanetary` | Interplanetary+ | Solar system, galaxy, or universe. |
